Match Image 1 exactly for color, shapes and simplified low-noise cel rendering. Clean dark line, large flat colors, one hard shadow per material, no painterly texture. Show separate isolated orthographic detail drawings with generous spacing; no character full body and no scenery. NO text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, logos or watermarks.
AUTHORITATIVE DETAILS TO DRAW: crown front/side/back, throat brooch, detachable cape neck fastening and back drape, gown layered hem/slit, three seal tablets bound/unbound.
EXACT OBJECT RULES: Exactly THREE identical flat elongated red diamond seal tablets in an active spell, each dark silver framed with ONE small circular center mark, joined by ONE plain dark chain when bound. In neutral turnarounds tablets are detached prop samples, not floating around body. Cape fastening and THREE-point crown front/back shown clearly.
HARD LOCKS: 黑发暗酒红发尾; 红眼; 王冠3主尖峰; 冠中央红菱石1枚; 喉部红菱胸针1枚; 施法封印片3枚; 无剑.
